direct_source_quote_length_guard: Only brief labels and scale text recorded, not copying source explanatory paragraphs
mandatory_registration_recipe: Read RHP6075 scan at original unresized resolution or obtain RCAHMS Fig517 archival scan with usage rights.
Identify 1547 line classifications before marking GCP: new English fort wall, reused medieval curtain, exterior ditch, older castle/garden/multi-phase terrain.
Acquire RCAHMS 2006–09 DGPS digital terrain and interpreted earthwork line layer in EPSG:27700.
Select at least four geometrically distinct historic-terrace/stonework/ditch tie points visible in both source plan and DGPS survey, retain per-point source confidence.
Compute registration residuals; report RMSE and maximum error, compare with scale/period alignment uncertainties, and manually review.
Digitize only original English artillery enclosure as separate derived geojson with source file hash, GCPs, analyst/reviewer, usage license and YearEnd policy.
Where footprint depends on invisible/reused structures, mark inferred segments as dashed/uncertain rather than all-solid verified.
Reject modern scheduling polygon, any 110×65 invented rectangle, convex hull of towns, and coastlines as ancient 1547 political land boundary.
